findings.title: Purge gap of the first embodiment cannot open by radial expansion, and has no outlet
findings.attack: Claim 16 'opens when the seat ring expands' and claim 17 'the radial expansion opening the purge gap' place the gap between the outer surface 38 and the core bore 22, while the seat ring is interference-fitted in that bore ([0035]). Radial expansion moves the outer surface towards the bore and closes, not opens, the gap; no path from the lower end of the gap past the locating shoulder 24 into the inflatable body is described. Not enabled under US 112(a), EPC Art 83, UK s.14(3).
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add the inventors' actual gap geometry (separating surfaces, direction, outlet path) to the description and FIG. 1/2 from their sketches; only if unavailable, delete or recast claims 16, 17, 40, 41.

findings.title: Genus claims 1, 2 and 4 rest on a mechanism not coherently disclosed in any embodiment
findings.attack: Claim 1 covers any 'deflectable element' opening any 'purge gap'; [0116] calls the principle 'of general application', yet the first embodiment's gap cannot open as described and the wiper ring embodiment's gap position, mounting and thickness are 'not stated'. Full-scope enablement (Amgen v Sanofi; Regeneron v Kymab; EPC Art 83/84) is exposed.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Supply the missing gap disclosure for the first embodiment and at least one stated gap topology for the wiper ring; narrowing claim 1 to a stated topology only as a fallback, for the human to decide.

findings.title: No drawings; the figure files are drafting instructions carrying internal references and damaging statements
findings.attack: The description refers to FIG. 1 to FIG. 8 but the package holds only a figure plan citing CONFIRMED.md, P1/01 and PF-1 and stating 'the disclosure does not explain how the purge gap opens', plus drawing instructions with draftsperson's notes. Missing drawings engage 35 USC 113, Rule 56 EPC and UK s.15; the statement is a sufficiency admission if filed.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Produce drawing sheets for FIG. 1 to FIG. 8, matching FIG. 1 to FIG. 3 to the inventors' sketches, and keep the plan and instructions out of anything filed.

findings.title: Deflectable element construction: 112(f) placeholder in the US and displacement reading under BRI
findings.attack: 'a deflectable element' with 'opened by deflection … closed by recovery' risks 112(f) treatment limited to the seat ring 30 and wiper ring 130; without 112(f), BRI of 'deflection' may cover rigid displacement and read on spring-loaded second poppets. EPO (G 1/24) and UK read [0048]'s 'undeflected shape' into the term.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Recite in claim 1 'a deflectable element which is elastically deflected from an undeflected shape', and add to [0048] the structural forms as examples of the class.

findings.title: Sealant-accumulation surfaces is defined by use
findings.attack: 'along sealant-accumulation surfaces bounding the purge gap' identifies surfaces by what happens in use ([0058]); in an apparatus claim this invites a clarity objection or is given no weight, adding nothing to novelty.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Recite 'along surfaces bounding the purge gap' in claims 1, 2 and 4, keeping the sealant context in the description.

findings.title: Range claims extend to alternatives for which the description says no ranges are stated
findings.attack: Claims 19, 25 (via 19) and 30 to 34 combine ranges with the polymer seat ring and the wiper ring, while [0093] and [0124] state the ranges are 'not stated' for those alternatives: Art 84 support objection now, Art 123(2) exposure on amendment, and a contrary statement quotable in the US.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Restructure dependencies so the range claims hang from the superelastic seat ring claims or claim 1 directly, not reciting the polymer or wiper combinations; or correct [0093]/[0124] if the inventors confirm the ranges apply.

findings.title: Austenite finish temperature has no fixed measuring method
findings.attack: 'an austenite finish temperature below 5 °C' is measured by 'a thermal analysis method, for example differential scanning calorimetry, unless stated otherwise' ([0074]); Af varies by method and the prototype value is not recorded ([0128]). Unclear parameter under Art 84 (Guidelines F-IV 4.11), 112(b), s.14(5)(b).
findings.least_narrowing_action: Name one measuring method in [0074], as used by the inventors or their supplier to specify the material.

findings.title: US multiple dependency on multiple dependent claims; claim fees in all three offices
findings.attack: Claim 8 'any one of claims 1 to 7' includes multiple dependent claim 6; claim 22 depends on multiple dependent claim 21; claims 49 and 54 depend on claim 48 and other multiple dependents. 37 CFR 1.75(c) forbids this. Sixty claims attract EPO fees beyond 15 and the higher band beyond 50, and the UK fee beyond 25.
findings.least_narrowing_action: File a US-specific claim set with single dependencies; counsel to set claim numbers per office.

findings.title: Lettered paragraph numbers
findings.attack: 37 CFR 1.52(b)(6) requires consecutive four-digit paragraph numbering; lettered numbers are non-standard.

findings.title: The evidence that over-travel and purge flow occurred is an audible snap
findings.attack: 'Over-travel was confirmed … by an audible snap on removal of the inflation device 84' ([0102]); no pressure differential across the valve, travel or flow was measured, and the cleaning attribution is 'their statement rather than a measured result' ([0131]). Under G 2/21 the effect relied on for inventive step is weakly evidenced.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add any existing measurement of differential, travel or flow to Example 1; otherwise keep effect statements tied to the bench outcome. Nothing is to be invented.

assumptions.text: A1. AI drafting and analysis aid, not legal advice; issues for qualified patent counsel.
A2. No priority document, abstract or drawing sheet in the package; figures.md and registry.md read as what would be filed for the figures.
A3. CGK: an annular gap bounded outside by a fixed bore narrows when the inner member expands radially; a part interference-fitted in a bore already bears on it.
A4. Legal authorities are named for counsel to check, not applied as conclusions; G 1/24 per https://ipkitten.blogspot.com/2025/06/eba-decides-g124-on-claim.html (accessed 2026-09-29).
A5. Prior-art references are those saved in prior-art/refs/, AI-retrieved and not human-verified.

open_questions.text: Q1. What is the prototype's actual purge gap geometry and outlet path; do FIG-1.png and FIG-2.png show it?
Q2. By which method was the prototype material's austenite finish temperature specified?
Q3. Do the stated ranges apply to the polymer seat ring and the wiper ring?
Q4. Was the pressure differential, travel or flow ever measured during an inflation?
Q5. For counsel: claim count per office and a US-specific claim set.
